svg.title: Tumble, the dog trainer of Whistle Meadow
svg.desc: Tumble, a large russet herding ball of cut paper with a moulded handle loop on top, seams, a lighter highlight panel, a few tooth marks and grass stains, sits on the meadow grass. Tumble has bright eyes, warm cheeks and a smile, waves with one stub arm and holds out a small biscuit with the other. A willow whistle hangs from the handle on a braided cord, and a treat pouch is clipped to Tumble's side. Beside Tumble a lean, long-legged, mostly white dog with a ginger head and a white blaze sits nicely with a head tilt, one ear perked with its tip folded and one flopped, a green paisley bandana and a small bone-shaped tag, its curled tail wagging and a tennis ball at its paws. A willow hoop stands on the left and a scent-trail flag on the right.
